name: Gotify
description: Send and receive push notifications through a simple API.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Gotify's database, app images, plugins and the first admin password (password.txt). Back this folder up.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Gotify web page and API, published on host as 6730

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: GOTIFY_DEFAULTUSER_NAME
variables.description: The name of the first admin user, made on the very first start. admin is fine.

variables.name: GOTIFY_DEFAULTUSER_PASS
variables.description: The first admin's password. Leave it blank and the app makes a random one on first start; find it in the app's logs, in the box marked CREDENTIALS. Only used on the very first start; change it later in Gotify under Users.
